claim: Demo — sample data, nothing is saved
sandbox: fresh browser context; send a sample request to an ephemeral demo workspace; assert only the demo-prefixed ID key exists and no cross-origin request occurs

claim: Try it with sample data opens an isolated demo in one click; /?demo=1 opens the same demo directly
sandbox: fresh browser context and empty storage; click the first-screen action, then open /?demo=1 directly; assert the banner, sample catalogue, and demo-only key

claim: The demo includes six sample products, two POA prices, stock notes, a request basket, and a seeded seller inbox
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; count products and POA prices, inspect stock notes and basket, then open the seeded seller inbox

claim: Prices can stay POA
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; inspect the blank-price sample item

claim: Export each request as CSV
where: how it works and seller request toolbar
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo/inbox; download CSV and assert one row for each sample request line

claim: Request export stays free
where: landing paid tier, seller workspace, terms, README
sandbox: fresh unlicensed browser context at /demo/inbox; export the seeded request and assert the downloaded CSV contains it

claim: Each client request keeps SKUs, quantities, contact details, and notes
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo/inbox; assert SKU, quantity, and PO fields in the sample request

claim: No checkout or card data
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; open request form and assert the no-payment notice and absence of card fields

claim: The service collects quote requests; it does not confirm an order, stock, shipping, or tax
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; inspect the request form and terms for the explicit unconfirmed-request boundary

claim: Client links use random 28-character tokens
sandbox: unit test generates two link tokens, checks length, and checks they differ

claim: Imports a product CSV with SKU, name, price, category, and stock note fields
sandbox: fresh seller workspace; import a one-row CSV and open that product through its client link

claim: CSV header names are case-insensitive
sandbox: parse a fixture whose six supported headings use mixed case and a space; assert every field and price is imported

claim: Prints a clean request sheet for PDF saving
sandbox: fresh demo workspace; invoke Print request and assert only the chosen request is marked for print

claim: A verified one-time license raises the 12-row and one-link free limits
sandbox: fresh seller tenant and recorded valid Sociobot response; consume the return token, save 13 rows, and create two active client links through the real backend

claim: The full workspace costs $15.71 USD as a one-time purchase
where: landing paid tier, seller workspace, README, Sociobot checkout
sandbox: fresh browser context; follow the real Sociobot checkout handoff into a recorded checkout fixture and assert the product name, $15.71 total, USD currency, and one-time cadence

claim: Checkout uses Sociobot as merchant of record, and a refunded license loses paid access
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the checkout target and legal disclosure, then use a recorded revoked-license response and assert paid access stays locked

claim: The client catalogue does not expose stock counts
sandbox: serialize a product returned by the catalogue API and assert there is no stock-count field

claim: There are no analytics, advertising scripts, remote fonts, or runtime CDNs
sandbox: fresh browser context; load the landing page and demo while recording every request origin

claim: The server does not retain demo requests
sandbox: create a sample workspace and read it through a separate backend state; the built-in sample is available without retained server state

claim: Reset demo removes the sample data from this browser
sandbox: fresh browser context; reset a demo and assert its submitted-request storage key is removed

claim: Paid imports support up to 5,000 rows
sandbox: fresh in-memory tenant; attempt a 5,001-row import and assert the server rejects it

claim: Only PORT is needed in production
sandbox: construct runtime configuration without environment values and assert the port and local paths default

claim: The server creates DATA_DIR and persists seller workspace data in SQLite
sandbox: fresh temporary directory; boot the storage layer, assert every seller data table exists, write representative data, reopen SQLite, and read it back

claim: The container builds the frontend and server, runs non-root, and uses /app/data for SQLite
sandbox: inspect the shipped Dockerfile for both build stages, the non-root runtime user, data path, volume, and default port

claim: /health returns the supplied build SHA
sandbox: construct the health response with a known build SHA and assert the response returns it unchanged

claim: Session storage holds the sign-in token; local storage holds the license verdict and isolated demo keys
sandbox: fresh browser context with recorded license verification; inspect exact session, license, and demo keys, then leave demo and assert its keys are discarded

claim: Sellers can delete a client request from their inbox
sandbox: fresh seller tenant; submit a request through its client link and delete it from the seller inbox

claim: Each Sociobot seller has a separate workspace
sandbox: fresh in-memory database; create two seller subjects and assert one seller cannot read the other's catalogue

claim: Sellers can sign in with Sociobot and open their own workspace
where: seller workflow and seller sign-in page
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the hosted CIAM redirect and product scope, then return a recorded seller identity through /auth/callback and assert its isolated workspace opens

claim: A seller can create a client link with a saved client or group name
where: landing workflow, seller workflow, seller workspace
sandbox: fresh seller workspace; create a link named Juniper Corner, reload the workspace, and assert the label remains beside its generated catalogue link

claim: An inactive license shows a notice and keeps paid limits locked
sandbox: fresh browser context; mock a revoked Sociobot verification response and assert the status notice and visible restore field
